in_english.name: Farjam
in_english.meaning: Farjam means salvation or divine redemption
in_english.long_meaning: Farjam is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It means salvation or divine redemption. The name signifies protection and divine care. Etymologically, it is derived from the Arabic root 'F-R-J' which conveys the sense of rescue or deliverance. In Islamic tradition, Farjam is significant as it is mentioned in the Quran in the context of salvation and redemption, reflecting a profound spiritual meaning and historical usage across Muslim cultures.
